svg.title: The leading program changes from task to task
svg.desc: Sixteen panels, four programs on four tasks. The ten seeds of each program spread widely; the final interquartile mean ranks SAC first on HalfCheetah, PPO (JAX) on Hopper and Swimmer, CrossQ on Walker2d.
svg.text: The leading program changes from task to task
Evaluation score along training, per program and task. Thin line: one random
seed. Thick line: interquartile mean of the ten seeds, with its 95% band.
Number above each panel: interquartile mean at the last step, the one the ranking uses; tinted ground for the leader of
the task. One vertical scale per task, starting at zero. SAC and CrossQ train for 0.2 million steps, PPO for one million.
Data: sim/results, seeds 0 to 9; band: percentile bootstrap
of the interquartile mean (numpy, 2,000 draws, seed 2026)
